name: Blender (headless 3D renderer for plates)
purpose: Offline 3D engine for plates HyperFrames composites: physically based light (glass, caustics, subsurface), volumetrics, rigid-body/cloth/particle/fluid simulation, real depth of field and motion blur, camera moves through 3D sets. Driven only through scripts/visual-director.py and the src/blender kit; never carries text.
capabilities: EEVEE and Cycles rendering from Python (bpy), headless with factory settings
Baked rigid-body, particle and cloth simulations with fixed seeds
PNG frame sequences (RGB or RGBA) encoded to H.264 MP4 or VP9-alpha WebM plates
version_constraints: Pinned to 5.2.4 LTS (supported to 2028-07); hashes per platform in specs/visual-engines.json. A different version is a different plate: every plate re-renders.

installation.instructions: python scripts/visual-director.py install-blender (downloads the pinned build from download.blender.org, verifies SHA-256, unpacks to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Blender on Windows, ~/Applications/Blender-5.2.4.app on macOS, ~/.local/opt on Linux). Override discovery with MOTION_LAB_BLENDER.

compatibility.notes: Verified on Windows 11 x64 with Intel Iris Xe (2026-11-24): EEVEE renders 720x1280 plates at about 2.9 s/frame (16 samples) after 40-70 s of shader compilation. Not yet run on the M2 render host (Metal backend for Cycles, EEVEE on Metal).

licensing.notes: Run as an external application; nothing linked or vendored. Rendered output belongs to its author (blender.org/about/license). Plate scripts import bpy only inside Blender.

security.notes: Started with --factory-startup (no user add-ons or startup scripts) and a workspace runner; writes only under projects/<slug>/renders/plates/. Installer downloads over HTTPS from download.blender.org and checks a pinned SHA-256.

approval_evidence: 2026-11-24, Windows host: installed 5.2.4 LTS (SHA-256 bbd78f89... matched the official list), rendered the hero-orbit plate for projects/lab-blender-hybrid (132 frames, 720x1280) and composited it in HyperFrames 0.8.226 (snapshots at 0.6, 2.2, 4.1 s show the plate under DOM text and gone after data-duration). Approval needs a render on the M2 host and one shipped film.
